title: TA VACANCY | Bright Futures 4 All
text:
TEACHER ASSISTANT

0.3 and 4.0 part time required – Croydon – £10.75 per hour (Trainee/Qualified)

As well as excellent subject knowledge and teaching skills, you must be willing to promote and adhere to our Christian ethos of: Faith, Love, Service and Resilience. Essential: a love of children and a desire to make a difference to London’s most neediest communities, whilst respecting the cultures of Croydon’s diverse ethnic communities. ​ Main requirements and duties Teaching assistants must have a qualification related to the role (e,g,) Level 3 or equivalent and will ideally have some First Aid training. With at least 1 years’ experience in a class. Have a working knowledge of the English national curriculum. Has worked within schools and holds high expectations of learning and behaviour Be a fun-loving, flexible and enthusiastic team-player. Can support the class-teacher with implementing teaching and tracking methods. Shares our company’s vision and Christian values. Can provide two references from recent past employers.
